params.body:
## Why

The head teacher asked for "the third term results analysed by class". The platform already computes that: the By term page shows the combined-term result analysis (subject × male/female/overall, fail/pass/mastery, average) and the histogram. But that page had **no PDF download** for either (`pdfParams => null`), only the per-period pages (Test 1 / Test 2 / Exam) had one. So the full-term analysis for six classes was a screen to read, not a document to send.

## What

- **`App\Domain\Reporting\Services\ResultAnalysis`**: the band machinery (fail < 40, pass 40-79, mastery ≥ 80, largest-remainder percentages), the core-or-all subject rule, and the full-term reading built on `PositionService::rankedReports` so analysis, positions and report cards can never disagree. `TermResultController` now delegates to it; nothing about the per-period analysis changes (existing tests untouched, still green).
- **`?scope=term`** on `term-grid.analysis` and `term-grid.histogram`: the full-term PDFs (`Analysis Grade 6 Term 3 (full term).pdf`). The By term page now links to them (analysis, histogram, blank histogram).
- **`php artisan results:analysis`**: the same two PDFs for every class of a term in one folder.
  ```
  php artisan results:analysis --term="Term 3"
  php artisan results:analysis --year="2025 - 2026" --term="Term 3" --class="Grade 4" --out=/media/usb/analysis --no-histogram
  ```
  Defaults: current school year, the term we are in (else the year's last), all classes in scorebook order, `storage/app/analysis/<year>/<term>/`. A class without marks that term is listed and skipped. Wrong term / year / class names are named in the error.
- `pdfText()` moved from `TermResultTest` to `TestCase` so the new test can read the PDFs the same way.
- README, docs/operations.md and CLAUDE.md mention the command.

## Checked

- `vendor/bin/phpunit`: 523 tests, 1761 assertions, green (3 new in `ResultsAnalysisTest`: the page links and both PDFs with exact band figures per sex; the command over three classes incl. an empty one, `--class`, `--no-histogram`; the error messages).
- Ran against the demo seed for `2025 - 2026` / Term 3: 11 classes, 22 PDFs, rendered and eyeballed Grade 6 (table and two histogram pages).
params.title: Result analysis: full-term PDFs and results:analysis for every class
